site.name: Counter-Strike Online World
site.tagline: The world never ended. Its soul is still here.

home.headline: Enter the world that never ended
home.subheadline: Every character, every weapon, every scenario and every song of Counter-Strike Online — preserved, connected, and open to everyone.
home.eosBody: On September 30, 2026 the last servers go dark after twelve years on Steam and eighteen since Korea. This archive keeps the lights on.
home.modesTitle: Every mode tells a different story
home.apiTitle: Build a bridge to this world
home.apiBody: A clean, versioned REST API with an OpenAPI spec. Pull characters, weapons, scenarios and lore into your own apps — free, attributed, forever.
